coordinates.object_orientation: Body long axis X, head -X, tail +X, dorsal +Z; front camera -Y shows broadside, side camera+X looks toward head along tail, top+Z, perspective(+X,-Y,+Z). Paired fins symmetric across Y.

concept.reason: Actual whole-body fossil Fig9E plus documented same-taxon published Fig13 anatomy reconstruction; sufficient reference without extra concept.

representation: Conservative whole-animal living reconstruction, not fossil slab or exact soft-tissue scan
primary_specimen: BMNH P.24745-P24736 as printed in Clack/Sharp/Long 2011 Fig9E, length215mm
scope: Retain entire original lungfish target. Correct inaccurate provisional continuous rear-fin wording: small separate first dorsal, greatly enlarged long-based second dorsal, separate small anal and caudal fins. No modern fused dorsal-tail-anal ribbon.

dimensions.basis: Only215mm is published fossil length. Depth/width/fin envelope are conservative working inferences following Fig9E and same-taxon Fig13 reconstruction; exact living thickness/fin pose not preserved.

must_preserve: Elongate body with moderately long tapered snout, not blunt modern lungfish head.
Small first dorsal visibly separated by a body gap from broad high posterior dorsal.
Large second dorsal with extended base, rounded high leading region and descending rear edge, NOT a narrow continuous ribbon.
Separate heterocercal tail with upward extended axis/lobe; retain visible separation from second dorsal and small ventral anal fin.
Two paired pectoral fins and two paired pelvic fins, fleshy bases and ray-supported tapered blades, not filament limbs.
No exposed internal bones in living reconstruction; illustrated skeleton informs anatomy only.
Subdued inferred color, modest non-photo scale cues; no invented camouflage, spikes or teeth display.
forbidden: Modern lungfish merged fin margin or symmetric round tail
Turn whole animal into slab, skeleton or partial fish
Use Scaumenacia or adjacent Fig13 taxon proportions
Claim width, coloration or fin pose as measured fossil traits
Labels, plinth, environment or concept-image generation
